Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Vihaan - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Hema - 38 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Vinod - 39 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Hema and Vinod stand near him.]

Vihaan: "Dad, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan writes in his notebook.]

Vihaan: "Hmm, I see."

[Vihaan talks to his father on the phone.]

Vihaan: "And then?"

[Vihaan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Hema (softly): "What a day to remember!"
